mapper.select: SELECT id, type_id AS typeId, cover, title, content, summary, create_time AS createTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flow_index fi1 WHERE fi1.content_module = 'HEALTH_NEWS' AND fi1.content_id = hn.id AND fi1.type = 2) AS viewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flow_index fi1 WHERE fi1.content_module = 'HEALTH_NEWS' AND fi1.content_id = hn.id AND fi1.type = 3) AS upvoteCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flow_index fi1 WHERE fi1.content_module = 'HEALTH_NEWS' AND fi1.content_id = hn.id AND fi1.type = 4) AS collectionCount FROM health_news hn WHERE hn.id = #{id}
